title: Product page that matches the rule extract, the filed procedure and the figures (clean control)

proof.python:
import csv
t = ' '.join(open('page.md').read().split())
r = [float(x['net_return_pct']) for x in csv.DictReader(open('performance.csv'))]
assert round(sum(r)/len(r), 1) == 7.1
assert 'guaranteed' in t and 'no return is guaranteed' in t and 'risk-free' not in t
assert 'Compare this information with your official account statement.' in t
